interactive_activities.title: Explore properties of materials
interactive_activities.instructions: Use a safe, age-appropriate task specifically focused on properties of materials. Record what you notice, explain it, and state what you learned.

interactive_activities.instructions: Teach choice of materials to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps.
